Pasadizo release: upstream sing-box `testing` plus Pasadizo's features (see the [README](https://github.com/pasadizo-net/pasadizo/blob/main/.github/README.md)).

Verify a download with `sha256sum --ignore-missing -c checksums.txt` and `gh attestation verify <file> --repo pasadizo-net/pasadizo`.

Not affiliated with sing-box or its authors.
